jobDescription:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Remote (EU)
Employment: Full-time

About the Role
We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to take models from prototype to production. You will design, train, and deploy machine-learning systems and own them in production alongside our platform and data teams.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, train, and evaluate machine-learning models for production use cases.
- Build and own model-serving and deployment pipelines.
- Productionize models with containers and orchestration.
- Collaborate with data engineering on large-scale feature pipelines.
- Monitor models in production and drive continuous improvement.

Required Skills
- Python for model development
- SQL for data access
- Deep-learning frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow
- scikit-learn for classical modeling
- MLOps and model deployment
- Docker for packaging
- Kubernetes for orchestration
- A major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Apache Spark for large-scale processing
- Workflow orchestration such as Airflow
- Strong statistics and experimentation background
